# llm-api-examples
> Copy-paste examples for OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral & local APIs
Maintained by aixisstudio. Related: Snitch (open-source app firewall). https://github.com/aixisstudio/llm-api-examples

## 🔌 OpenAI
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
r = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])
print(r.choices[0].message.content)
```

## 🧠 Anthropic (Claude)
```python
import anthropic
c = anthropic.Anthropic()
m = c.messages.create(model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024,
                      messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])
print(m.content[0].text)
```

## 🇫🇷 Mistral
```python
from mistralai import Mistral
m = Mistral(api_key="...")
r = m.chat.complete(model="mistral-small-latest",
                    messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])
print(r.choices[0].message.content)
```

## 🏠 Local (Ollama — OpenAI-compatible)
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1", api_key="ollama")
r = client.chat.completions.create(model="qwen3", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])
print(r.choices[0].message.content)
```
